PullRequest.Title: Add change scope review guidance
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

- add repository-wide guidance to establish the intended scope before implementing or reviewing a change
- require reviewers to account for each changed file and subsystem
- flag changes that only make a symptom disappear without addressing its underlying cause
- recommend reverting or splitting unrelated cleanup and speculative improvements

## Why

Ports the review guidance from microsoft/vscode-engineering#3969 so Copilot applies the same scope discipline when working in the VS Code repository.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`

Scenarios.Scenario: Copilot chat, coding, and code-review requests in the VS Code repository consume the repository-wide custom-instructions file.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The instruction file is discovered/read and its contents are incorporated into an agent prompt before the request can proceed. The diff adds five fixed-size guidance bullets but no new stage or operation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing instruction file per applicable workspace discovery; the diff only increases that file by a fixed roughly 1 KB.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same .github/copilot-instructions.md file was already located and consumed; it was five bullets shorter.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Instruction loading may precede prompt construction, but no additional filesystem call is introduced and the byte increase is constant and negligible relative to the existing file.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: The instruction contents may be serialized into the existing model request by the external Copilot request path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One fixed-size text addition in each applicable prompt; no per-file, per-diagnostic, or collection-dependent fan-out.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same request already carried repository instructions; only these fixed-size bullets were absent.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds a small constant number of prompt bytes/tokens to an already-required request without adding a network round trip or changing concurrency.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant five-bullet addition independent of workspace file count, changed-file count, review findings, session history, and request concurrency.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Unchanged: request orchestration determines concurrency; this diff adds no loop, queue, parallel fan-out, limiter change, or additional request.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold discovery/read and any warm cached instruction state have the same keys and invalidation behavior; the diff changes only file content, not cache lifecycle, misses, coalescing, or negative caching.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence that prompt payload size increases slightly; high confidence that there is no realistic actionable regression because call count, lifecycle, concurrency, and asymptotic scaling are unchanged.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact tokenizer and external prompt-assembly behavior are not represented fully in this repository, but the added content is visibly fixed-size and introduces no extra operation or scaling dimension.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The only cost is a small bounded prompt-size increase inherent to adding repository guidance, with no new boundary call, hot-path repetition, unbounded retention, or meaningful critical-path amplification.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed the complete one-file diff and traced repository-instruction consumption. The change adds only fixed-size guidance text; it does not introduce runtime code, additional I/O/network calls, repeated work, retention, eager initialization, or concurrency changes. No performance findings were submitted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
